sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blk(f,c):
    best=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==c:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if max(cols)<32 and (best is None or n['pixels']>best[5]):
                best=(c,min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols),n['pixels'])
    return best
def tok(f,c):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==c and n['pixels']>=4:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),min(cols))
    return None
print("before: R",blk(current_frame,'R'),"b",blk(current_frame,'b'),"N",tok(current_frame,'N'))
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48},{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':48},'UP','UP','UP','UP','UP','RIGHT','RIGHT'])
print("after: R",blk(current_frame,'R'),"b",blk(current_frame,'b'),"N",tok(current_frame,'N'),"Y",tok(current_frame,'Y'))
print("board_changed:",r.get('board_changed'),"done:",r.get('done'),"level_completed:",r.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def blk(f,c):
    best=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==c:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if max(cols)<32 and (best is None or n['pixels']>best[5]):
                best=(c,min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols),n['pixels'])
    return best
def tok(f,c):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==c and n['pixels']>=4:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),min(cols))
    return None
